title: Hezekiah’s Illness and Visitors from Babylon

questions.question: What happened to Hezekiah "in those days"?
options: He became sick and was at the point of death
questions.correctAnswer: He became sick and was at the point of death
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:1 (ESV): "In those days Hezekiah became sick and was at the point of death."

questions.question: What did Isaiah tell Hezekiah about his illness?
options: Set your house in order, for you shall die
questions.correctAnswer: Set your house in order, for you shall die
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:1 (ESV): "...Set your house in order, for you shall die, you shall not recover."

questions.question: How many years did God add to Hezekiah's life?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:6 (ESV): "and I will add fifteen years to your life."

questions.question: What sign was given to Hezekiah that the Lord would heal him?
options: The shadow went back ten steps on the dial of Ahaz
questions.correctAnswer: The shadow went back ten steps on the dial of Ahaz
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:11 (ESV): "...and he brought the shadow back ten steps..."

questions.question: Who sent envoys to Hezekiah?
options: Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylon
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:12 (ESV): "At that time Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent envoys..."

questions.question: What did Hezekiah show the envoys?
options: All his treasure house, silver, gold, spices, precious oil
questions.correctAnswer: All his treasure house, silver, gold, spices, precious oil
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:13 (ESV): "...he showed them all his treasure house, the silver, the gold, the spices, the precious oil..."

questions.question: What did Isaiah prophesy would happen to Hezekiah's treasures?
options: They would be carried to Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: They would be carried to Babylon
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:17 (ESV): "Behold, the days are coming, when all that is in your house... shall be carried to Babylon. Nothing shall be left..."

questions.question: What was used to heal Hezekiah's boil?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:7 (ESV): "And Isaiah said, 'Bring a cake of figs.' And let them take and lay it on the boil, that he may recover."

questions.question: How did Hezekiah react to Isaiah's prophecy of exile?
options: The word of the LORD is good (thinking there will be peace in my days)
questions.correctAnswer: The word of the LORD is good (thinking there will be peace in my days)
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:19 (ESV): "...not, 'The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good.' For he thought, 'Why not, if there will be peace and security in my days?'"

questions.question: What engineering feat is mentioned in the summary of Hezekiah's life?
options: He made the pool and the conduit and brought water into the city
questions.correctAnswer: He made the pool and the conduit and brought water into the city
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:20 (ESV): "...how he made the pool and the conduit and brought water into the city..."

questions.question: Before Isaiah had gone out of the middle court, what happened?
options: The word of the LORD came to him
questions.correctAnswer: The word of the LORD came to him
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:4 (ESV): "And before Isaiah had gone out of the middle court, the word of the LORD came to him..."

questions.question: What day did Isaiah say Hezekiah would go up to the house of the Lord?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:5 (ESV): "...On the third day you shall go up to the house of the LORD."

questions.question: Who succeeded Hezekiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:21 (ESV): "And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: What choice did Hezekiah have for the sign?
options: Whether the shadow should go forward ten steps or go back ten steps
questions.correctAnswer: Whether the shadow should go forward ten steps or go back ten steps
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:9 (ESV): "...Shall the shadow go forward ten steps, or shall it go back ten steps?"

questions.question: Why did Hezekiah choose for the shadow to go back?
options: It is an easy thing for the shadow to lengthen ten steps
questions.correctAnswer: It is an easy thing for the shadow to lengthen ten steps
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 20:10 (ESV): "And Hezekiah answered, 'It is an easy thing for the shadow to lengthen ten steps. Rather let the shadow go back ten steps.'"

key_verse_text: Turn back, and say to Hezekiah the leader of my people, Thus says the LORD, the God of David your father: I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day you shall go up to the house of the LORD. (ESV)
